name: Hiring manager intro
description: For a candidate approaching a hiring manager directly, bypassing the queue. Leads with proof of work rather than interest in the role, since the manager's problem is signal, not volume.
audience: Hiring managers at companies with a live role you can genuinely do. Ten to twenty targets, each one researched.

variants: {{firstName|Hi}} — you're hiring for something I've done twice before. Rather than go through the portal I thought I'd connect and say so directly.
Hi {{firstName|there}} — I've built exactly the thing your open role describes. Connecting to make the case in two lines rather than a cover letter.
Thanks {{firstName|there}}. The relevant part: I've shipped this twice, most recently owning it end to end at {{company|my last company}}. Happy to send two links rather than a CV. Worth a look?
Short version, {{firstName|there}}: I've done the job in the ad, twice. Two links tell the story better than my CV — shall I send them?
{{firstName|Hi}} — happy to go through the normal process if you'd rather; I just didn't want the application to be one of two hundred with no context attached.
If the process is the process, {{firstName|there}}, no problem — I'll apply properly. I'd just rather you knew the name when it lands.
I'll leave you to it, {{firstName|there}}. Good luck with the search — and if the shortlist doesn't work out, I'm still here.
Last message, {{firstName|there}}. Genuinely good luck with the hire. Keep me in mind if it reopens.
